hero4.eyebrow: For families settling in a Spanish-speaking country - and for digital nomads and travelers finding their place.
hero4.headline: Live your new country in Spanish - together, as a family
hero4.sub: It complements the local school: ten minutes a day of Spanish and English with Pere & Titi, inspired by international bilingual schools. Real learning instead of cartoons, while you're busy with housework or your remote job.
hero4.price: Then $11 a month only if you stay. On the web, WhatsApp and Telegram.
hero4.preview: Not ready? Try 20 messages without an account
hero4.card1: While you work and your child learns with Pere & Titi, EspaLuz accompanies you on WhatsApp and Telegram. From everyday conversations and unfamiliar customs to school messages and doctor's visits, write, speak or send a photo. She remembers your family's context, helps you understand the language and culture around you, and find your own words in Spanish and English.
hero4.card2Title: For your child, ten minutes a day
hero4.card2: Pere & Titi's voice classroom (ages 5-8: kinder, 1st and 2nd grade) walks a path of 12 school units at your child's own level, from "Me and my family" to "My friends", in Spanish and English. Your child talks with the two heroes, traces letters and syllables, paints, plays music and games, and can show a photo of a drawing or homework. Every five stars bring a new sticker, and when energy drops, Titi calls a short movement break. After every lesson you get a one-minute report.
hero4.card3Title: For the whole family, on every channel
hero4.card3: One family, one memory across WhatsApp, Telegram and the web: she knows who is who and what each of you is working on. Beyond language and practicalities, she helps you understand and adapt to a new culture - its rhythm of life, social customs, ways of communicating and connecting, traditions and everyday habits. Step by step, you find your place in your new country.
hero4.promiseTitle: EspaLuz walks the long road with your family

creator.title: About the creator
creator.role: Founder, AIdeazz AI Lab · Former IT executive and Chief Legal Officer in national e-government
creator.name: Elena Revicheva
creator.story1: In 2022 I moved to Panama with three generations of my family: my one-year-old daughter and my parents. None of us spoke Spanish. Together we learned what it means to navigate everyday life without speaking the local language: the doctor's appointment you cannot fully follow, the meeting at your child's school, unfamiliar paperwork, and the small daily moments that make you feel like an outsider.
creator.story2: Life in a new country doesn't happen by appointment. It happens everywhere: at the pharmacy counter, on the phone with the landlord, at the roadside, at the school gate. I needed help right there, in my pocket, any hour of the day: a companion I could trust to tell me the truth and give me the exact words people really use here. Not a textbook phrase, but what to say, and how to say it, in that moment. No app could do that. So I built it.
creator.meansTitle: What that means for your family:
creator.m1: EspaLuz grew out of real family life, not an abstract idea of language learning. She helps your family handle everyday situations while learning in both languages.
creator.m2: My background in legal governance and public digital services shapes how I build: privacy and reliability first.
creator.m3Lead: Built to grow with your family.
creator.m3: On WhatsApp, Telegram and the web, day and night. Children have their own class with Pere and Titi, where they talk, read, trace letters and earn stars.
creator.closing: EspaLuz started with my own family's need to feel at home in Panama. Today I build it so other families can find that feeling too.
creator.connectBody: For partnerships, press or work with AIdeazz AI Lab: my portfolio and professional profile are here.
creator.buildBody: The future of learning is warm, culturally aware and family-focused.
creator.sub: AIdeazz AI Lab · Former Chief Legal Officer, e-government

greetings-basics.title: Basic Greetings & Introductions
greetings-basics.description: Learn essential greetings and how to introduce yourself in Spanish

greeting-translation-1.q: How do you say "Hello, how are you?" in Spanish?
greeting-translation-1.e: This is the most common greeting in Spanish. "Hola" means hello, and "¿cómo estás?" means how are you.

greeting-multiple-choice-1.e: "Mucho gusto" literally means "much pleasure" and is used when meeting someone for the first time.

family-vocabulary.title: Family Members
family-vocabulary.description: Learn vocabulary for family members and relationships

family-translation-1.q: How do you say "My sister" in Spanish?
family-translation-1.e: "Mi" means "my" and "hermana" means "sister". For brother, you would say "hermano".

family-fill-blank-1.q: Complete: "Tengo una _____ muy inteligente" (I have a very smart daughter)

daily-activities.title: Daily Activities & Routines
daily-activities.description: Express what you do every day in Spanish

activities-multiple-choice-1.e: "Desayunar" means to have breakfast. "Almorzar" is lunch and "cenar" is dinner.

numbers-time.title: Numbers & Telling Time
numbers-time.description: Learn numbers 1-100 and how to tell time in Spanish

time-translation-1.q: How do you ask "What time is it?" in Spanish?
time-translation-1.e: This is the standard way to ask for the time in Spanish.

restaurant-ordering.title: Ordering Food at a Restaurant
restaurant-ordering.description: Learn how to order food and drinks like a local

restaurant-multiple-choice-1.q: How do you politely ask for the check?
restaurant-multiple-choice-1.e: This is the polite way to ask for the check. "Por favor" makes it more courteous.
